fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Dark blue paint on the doors, bed sides and fenders looks somewhat flat rather than deep and glossy
Black plastic bumpers front and rear and the black mirror look faded and grayish
Black steel wheels look dull, with some dust on the lower panels and rocker area
message: Hi Patrick, we saw your listing for the F-150. The blue paint looks a little flat in the photos, and the black bumpers and mirror have faded to gray. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including a buff and wax and trim restoration, so the truck photographs as clean as you describe it. Would you like a quote?
